_README: FROZEN acceptance-coverage debt ceiling — enforced by
Semantics: ceilings.status.<status> and ceilings.debt_class.<A|B|C|D> are the
MAXIMUM number of criteria that may carry that status / class. Measured >
ceiling => CI FAILS. ceilings.total_criteria is a FLOOR, not a ceiling: the
corpus may grow, never shrink, so deleting an inconvenient `partial` row
cannot read as progress. Measured < ceiling => CI prints the tightened block
for you to paste back here; lowering a ceiling after real work is expected.
Every number here is MEASURED DEBT, not an allowance. There is no headroom by
design: a ceiling set above the measured figure would silently license the
next unproven criterion. Raising one is an adjudication recorded in
This ratchet bounds how much of the acceptance contract is UNPROVEN. It is not
a project-completion figure: a criterion counted here may well be implemented
correctly — the claim is only that nothing in the suite asserts it.

provenance.slice: ADIM 49 — RC §6.7 P1-Gate3 follow-through (class-B debt, batch 02: external-object run provenance, docs 03/04/05)
provenance.conditions: static scan; ast + title extraction against the live test tree; no database, no network, no test run
provenance.supersedes: the ADIM 48 freeze (118 partial / 8 uncovered; A1 B87 C6 D32, base 7dd1dfe). Nothing was reclassified and no criterion was deleted: this slice closed FIVE class-B criteria on the external work-object line (TL-12, TL-20, TS-11, TS-21, AOS-21) by building the harness they all lacked — a COMPLETED Backtest Run over a composition containing an external object. partial fell 118 -> 113 and class B fell 87 -> 82. The uncovered, A, C and D ceilings are untouched.

adjudication.why_a_ceiling_and_not_a_failure: Turning 139 open criteria into a hard CI failure blocks every unrelated PR behind work no single slice can do. Leaving them unbounded is how the number grew unnoticed. The ceiling is the same trade frontend/e2e/a11y-baseline.json already makes: today's debt is frozen, and only GROWTH is red.
adjudication.class_D_is_not_test_debt: 32 of the open criteria name an error code, model field, validator or Agent Tool Gateway member that does not exist in backend/src. No test can close them; counting them as coverage debt budgets product work to a test slice. They are ratcheted separately so that closing class B cannot mask class D growing.
adjudication.class_C_is_never_closable: 6 criteria rest on a clause that is not assertable by nature — a statement about the V18 mockup document, another page's document scope, a V1 feature deliberately left closed (retention auto-purge, doc 20 §16), or a scenario Production cannot construct (CP-06, SUPPORTED_TARGET_RUNTIMES == {python}). Their ceiling must never be driven to zero; driving it down would mean someone invented a product to satisfy a document sentence.
adjudication.O-31_active_run_refusal_name: Three page documents named ONE refusal three ways: ACTIVE_RUN_DEPENDENCY (doc 03 §14, doc 04 §15), DELETE_BLOCKED_BY_RUNNING_JOB (doc 20 §15) and OBJECT_IN_ACTIVE_RUN (doc 01/15). Only the last ships. Settled the O-02 way — the SHIPPED name is canonical, the other two are historical — and pinned by backend/tests/integration/test_backtest_persistence.py::test_active_run_blocks_work_object_delete, which now asserts the wire code and http_status 409 instead of the exception class alone.
adjudication.class_B_batches_are_deliberately_small: 101 open class-B criteria cannot be closed in one pass without the review degenerating into a rubber stamp — and a criterion marked covered by a test that does not actually prove it is worse than one honestly left partial. Batches are therefore scoped to one page document and one surface (batch 01 = doc 05, backend). Each closed clause cites a node that fails when the behaviour is removed; where the assertion could plausibly pass vacuously it was negative-controlled by hand (see the notes on TL-03, TL-15 and TL-17 in acceptance_semantic_map.yaml).
adjudication.TL_11_c3_is_very_likely_class_C_not_B: ADIM 49 finding, recorded rather than acted on. TL-11.c3 names a run over an ALLOCATION-ENABLED composition. Shared capital allocation is fail-closed at ADMISSION in this build (domain/allocation/capability.py SHARED_ALLOCATION_STATUS = 'future_dev'; commands/backtest_run.py raises ALLOCATION_SHARED_MODE_NOT_IN_BUILD before any run, manifest or job exists), so the run the clause describes cannot be constructed and NO test can close it. That is the class C definition, not class B. It was NOT moved: B -> C would RAISE the C ceiling, and ceilings only fall except by adjudication. ADIM 48's kickoff recommended this row as closable; that was wrong. Two such findings are now open — this and TL-16 (c4 wants a 409 field that does not exist, so class D).
